description: Source code implementing WAN policy priority state machine for interface management, including state transitions, actions, and main policy thread.

methods.name: WanMgr_Policy_FM_SelectWANActive
methods.description: Selects primary and secondary WAN interfaces based on priority and status.

methods.name: WanMgr_CheckAllIfacesDown
methods.description: Checks if all WAN interfaces are down.

methods.name: Transition_Start
methods.description: Initial transition to interface down state.

methods.name: Transition_PrimaryInterfaceSelected
methods.description: Handles transition when primary interface is selected.

methods.name: Transition_PrimaryInterfaceDeSelected
methods.description: Handles transition when primary interface is deselected.

methods.name: Transition_PrimaryInterfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles transition when primary interface changes.

methods.name: Transition_SecondaryInterfaceSelected
methods.description: Handles transition when secondary interface is selected.

methods.name: Transition_SecondaryInterfaceDeSelected
methods.description: Handles transition when secondary interface is deselected.

methods.name: Transition_SecondaryInterfaceUp
methods.description: Handles transition when secondary interface comes up.

methods.name: Transition_SecondaryInterfaceDown
methods.description: Handles transition when secondary interface goes down.

methods.name: State_WanDown
methods.description: State when WAN interfaces are down, manages interface selection.

methods.name: State_PrimaryWanActive
methods.description: State when primary WAN is active, monitors interface status.

methods.name: State_SecondaryWanActive
methods.description: State when secondary WAN is active, monitors interface status.

methods.name: State_PrimaryWanActiveSecondaryWanUp
methods.description: State when primary and secondary WAN are both up, manages failover.

methods.name: State_WaitingForInterfaceSMExit
methods.description: State waiting for interface state machine to exit.

methods.name: WanMgr_Policy_PrimaryPriorityPolicy
methods.description: Main thread implementing the primary priority WAN policy state machine.
